about: Fan-made versions of official KING posts (owner, 27 Oct 2026). Collected by hand from public X / Instagram posts (replies and quote posts; logged-out X shows only a few, so the list grows as more are found or submitted). Images are hotlinked from the fan's own post and every tile links back to it; nothing is re-hosted. Add items newest first. Instagram: 28 Oct 2026 sweep of 14 hashtags (#kingposter, #kingmovie, #kingkhan, #srk, #kingsrk, #srkking, #srkedit, #srkfanart, #shahrukhkhan, #srkfans, #king2026, #kingteaser, #qaatilnahiaashiqhoon) read through the owner's logged-in Instagram; 495 posts about the poster were looked at by eye and only fan-made art, edits, memes and theories are listed here (news cards and reposts of the official poster are not). Instagram thumbnails are kept small (360 px) in assets/king-fans/ig/ because Instagram image links expire and throttle; each tile links to the fan's own post; likes and comments as read on 28 Oct. X deep sweep 28 Oct 2026 (~15:30 IST): 1,302 X posts read (searches, the quotes and replies of @iamsrk's and @redchilliesent's poster posts); of 497 posts with images, 173 were reposts of the official poster, the other 324 were checked by eye and the fan-made versions added (same art posted twice counted once). Second X sweep 28 Oct 2026 (~15:40 IST): 304 more X posts read (15 searches, posts since 27 Oct); 173 images, 50 of them reposts of the official poster, the other 123 checked by eye and 24 new fan-made versions added. Second Instagram sweep 28 Oct 2026 (~15:50 IST): the same hashtags plus #srkian returned 470 posts since the poster; the 73 new ones posted after 12:30 IST on 28 Oct were checked by eye and 9 added (likes and comments as read then).
